summary: Tech is doing the heavy lifting again, with the Nasdaq touching a fresh record on AI momentum while the Dow lags and oil slides.
market_note: S&P futures up, oil down, and 10-year yields climbing, so watch whether bonds spoil the tech party.

items.why: Momentum from Friday's Q3 deliveries beat of 486,532 vehicles versus about 450k expected, plus a reported order for 50 Tesla Semis from IMC Logistics and fresh buzz around the robotaxi push.
Continuing last week's rally after its Connect hardware event and reports of a new in-house AI chip; BofA reiterated a Buy with an $835 target, lifting AI infrastructure sentiment.
Riding the AI trade as the Nasdaq hits a fresh record; investor Dan Niles called Nvidia the tip of the spear for AI, and Barron's flagged Nvidia among the day's drivers.
One of the day's standouts in Investor's Business Daily's live market coverage, climbing with the broader AI-led tech rally as the Nasdaq sets a new high.
